content.text: autonomous overproduction of cortisol by adrenal gland
: at high levels, cortisol acts like a mineralocorticoid (aldosterone) & stimulates sodium absorption (⇡ BP) & potassium excretion (hypokalemia)
(velvety, darkening of the skin esp. around neck & armpits)
rule out exogenous Cushing syndrome d/t steroid use (patient HX)
▪︎free cortisol in urine ⇡ ≥3x ULN on ≥2 measurements = ⊕
➂ overnight low-dose (1mg) dexamethasone suppression test
▪︎done to check if adrenal gland is making too much cortisol
⤷ pituitary MRI to confirm presence of pituitary adenoma
⤷ imaging to locate tumor (CXR, CT, MTI, PET)
⤷ adrenal CT to confirm presence of adrenal tumor
